mapper.select: SELECT a.countryKey, b.relativeCountryKey, b.afterRatio, b.today, ROUND(1 / b.afterRatio, 8) AS curCurrency, b.afterRatio - b.beforeRatio AS compareYesterday FROM CURRENCY_COUNTRY_MAP AS a INNER JOIN CURRENCY_VOLUME_MAP AS b ON a.countryKey = b.countryKey WHERE a.countryKey = #{originCountryKey} AND b.relativeCountryKey = #{relativeCountryKey};
